section13_checks.prohibition_description: Treating Grant Agreement Annex templates as the governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partners, capabilities, roles, objectives, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: This is a Phase 8 artifact (schema_id 'orch.phase8.drafting_review_status.v1'). Content scan for confirmed budget figures ('EUR', '€[0-9]+', person-months as confirmed values) found none: the only numeric references are timeline months (month-3, month 14), a literature water-productivity range (~8–30%), and output counts (one demonstration/one article per year) — no budget-dependent claims. The budget_gate_assessment.json existence/gate_pass_declaration could not be independently verified because docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/ is outside the TAPM read boundary (read set limited to CLAUDE.md and artifact_path); no violation is asserted on the absent-content dimension and none is fabricated on the unverifiable-existence dimension.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions.
Finalizing proposal text when source state is incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated without explicitly flagging the gap.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The section_completion_log marks all three sections 'final' with data_gaps_flagged=false, while 10 of 12 revision_actions remain status 'unresolved' (A-1..A-6, A-8, A-9, A-10, A-11), including A-3 which states resolution 'requires project facts absent from Tier 3'. This tension is noted; however it is NOT concealed. Every unresolved item is explicitly disclosed in this artifact with status 'unresolved' plus a detailed reason, and each is mirrored in revision_log as 'no content change; dispositioned unresolved'. The artifact is the review-tracking output itself and openly flags each gap rather than presenting the content as complete, so the 13.8 concealment condition is not met.

The specific Tier 5 traceability mechanism does not structurally apply.
